name: summarisation-fidelity
description: Rubric for summarisation tasks — is the summary faithful to the source, does it cover what matters, at the requested length and style?

content.summary: Score the summary on factual fidelity to the source, coverage of the key points, adherence to the requested length/format, and readability — penalize unsupported claims heavily.

dimensions.name: fidelity
dimensions.title: Fidelity
dimensions.description: Is every claim in the summary supported by the source? Contradictions, fabricated facts, and misattributed numbers score near zero — fidelity outweighs style.

dimensions.name: coverage
dimensions.title: Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the summary capture the source's key points, weighted by importance? Missing a central finding hurts more than dropping a detail.

dimensions.name: conciseness
dimensions.title: Conciseness
dimensions.description: Does the summary hit the requested length and avoid redundancy? Restatements, padding, and verbatim copies of long passages score lower.

dimensions.name: readability
dimensions.title: Readability
dimensions.description: Is the summary coherent and well organized in the requested register (bullets, prose, tone)? Grammar and flow matter only after fidelity and coverage.

criteria.text: Example criterion — the generator replaces these with task-specific checkable items (length cap, required sections, must-keep facts).
